paragraphs.source_en: The autumn of the fourteenth year of Tenbun, Okazaki.

units.source_en: The autumn of the fourteenth year of Tenbun, Okazaki.
units.source_zh: 天文十四年，秋，冈崎。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天文十四年，秋，冈崎。

paragraphs.source_en: Torches had been lit in the courtyard. The eastern sky was gradually whitening, and the flames no longer burned as fiercely as before. The commanders sat in the firelight, their shadows wavering on the walls, while an air of desolation hung over everything.

units.source_en: Torches had been lit in the courtyard.
units.source_zh: 庭院里点起了火把。

units.source_en: The eastern sky was gradually whitening, and the flames no longer burned as fiercely as before.
units.source_zh: 东方的天空渐渐发白，火焰已经不如先前猛烈。

units.source_en: The commanders sat in the firelight, their shadows wavering on the walls, while an air of desolation hung over everything.
units.source_zh: 部将们坐在灯光下，影子在墙壁上摇曳，处处流露出凄惨的气氛。

paragraphs.source_zh: 庭院里点起了火把。东方的天空渐渐发白，火焰已经不如先前猛烈。部将们坐在灯光下，影子在墙壁上摇曳，处处流露出凄惨的气氛。

paragraphs.source_en: Matsudaira Hirotada sat in the center, with Abe Ōkura and his younger brother Shirōbei on his right, and Sakai Uta-no-suke and Ishikawa Aki on his left. Matsudaira Geki, the Ōkubo brothers, Honda Heihachirō, and Abe Shirōgorō were also seated in the circle. Every man was fully armed, his expression grave.

units.source_en: Matsudaira Hirotada sat in the center, with Abe Ōkura and his younger brother Shirōbei on his right, and Sakai Uta-no-suke and Ishikawa Aki on his left.
units.source_zh: 松平广忠坐在中间，右手是阿部大藏和其弟四郎兵卫，左手是酒井雅乐助和石川安艺。

units.source_en: Matsudaira Geki, the Ōkubo brothers, Honda Heihachirō, and Abe Shirōgorō were also seated in the circle.
units.source_zh: 另外还有松平外记、大久保兄弟、本多平八郎、阿部四郎五郎，他们围坐在一起。

units.source_en: Every man was fully armed, his expression grave.
units.source_zh: 人人全副武装，个个表情严肃。

paragraphs.source_zh: 松平广忠坐在中间，右手是阿部大藏和其弟四郎兵卫，左手是酒井雅乐助和石川安艺。另外还有松平外记、大久保兄弟、本多平八郎、阿部四郎五郎，他们围坐在一起。人人全副武装，个个表情严肃。

paragraphs.source_en: “Bring Takechiyo here.” Hirotada ordered. His face was expressionless. Beneath his helmet, his pale forehead reflected the light, lending his armored figure a mournful air and even calling to mind a doll displayed for the Girls’ Festival.

units.source_en: “Bring Takechiyo here.”
units.source_zh: “把竹千代带来。”

units.source_en: Hirotada ordered.
units.source_zh: 广忠吩咐道。

units.source_en: His face was expressionless. Beneath his helmet, his pale forehead reflected the light, lending his armored figure a mournful air and even calling to mind a doll displayed for the Girls’ Festival.
units.source_zh: 他面无表情，头盔下，苍白的额头反射着灯光，为全副武装的他增添了几分哀愁，甚至让人想起了女儿节的玩偶。

paragraphs.source_zh: “把竹千代带来。”广忠吩咐道。他面无表情，头盔下，苍白的额头反射着灯光，为全副武装的他增添了几分哀愁，甚至让人想起了女儿节的玩偶。

paragraphs.source_en: Hirotada’s aunt, Zuinen-in, answered the summons and entered, carrying Takechiyo to him.

units.source_en: Hirotada’s aunt, Zuinen-in, answered the summons and entered, carrying Takechiyo to him.
units.source_zh: 广忠的姑母随念院应声进来，抱着竹千代来到他面前。

paragraphs.source_zh: 广忠的姑母随念院应声进来，抱着竹千代来到他面前。

paragraphs.source_en: “I leave him in your care, Aunt.” Hirotada said softly. Zuinen-in nodded.

units.source_en: “I leave him in your care, Aunt.”
units.source_zh: “他就交给姑母了。”

units.source_en: Hirotada said softly.
units.source_zh: 广忠轻声说道。

units.source_en: Zuinen-in nodded.
units.source_zh: 随念院点点头。

paragraphs.source_zh: “他就交给姑母了。”广忠轻声说道。随念院点点头。

paragraphs.source_en: Abe Ōkura and Sakai Uta-no-suke turned their faces away, unable to bear the sight. Honda Heihachirō glanced into the courtyard and said, “It will soon be the fourth quarter of the Hour of the Tiger.”

units.source_en: Abe Ōkura and Sakai Uta-no-suke turned their faces away, unable to bear the sight.
units.source_zh: 阿部大藏和酒井雅乐助扭开头，有所不忍。

units.source_en: Honda Heihachirō glanced into the courtyard and said, “It will soon be the fourth quarter of the Hour of the Tiger.”
units.source_zh: 本多平八郎往院子里看了看，道：“马上就到寅时四刻了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿部大藏和酒井雅乐助扭开头，有所不忍。本多平八郎往院子里看了看，道：“马上就到寅时四刻了。”

paragraphs.source_en: An attendant brought in sake and victory chestnuts. Still carrying Takechiyo, Zuinen-in moved behind Hirotada and tried to soothe the fussing child.

units.source_en: An attendant brought in sake and victory chestnuts.
units.source_zh: 侍从端上了酒和胜栗。

units.source_en: Still carrying Takechiyo, Zuinen-in moved behind Hirotada and tried to soothe the fussing child.
units.source_zh: 随念院抱着竹千代走到广忠身后，哄着喧闹不止的孩子。

paragraphs.source_zh: 侍从端上了酒和胜栗。随念院抱着竹千代走到广忠身后，哄着喧闹不止的孩子。

paragraphs.source_en: Hirotada raised the unglazed earthenware cup, took a sip, and passed it among the men. No one spoke, yet there was no sense of tragic heroism; indeed, the mood was far easier than it had been while Hirotada gazed at Takechiyo.

units.source_en: Hirotada raised the unglazed earthenware cup, took a sip, and passed it among the men.
units.source_zh: 广忠端起素陶的酒杯，饮了一口，递给众人。

units.source_en: No one spoke, yet there was no sense of tragic heroism; indeed, the mood was far easier than it had been while Hirotada gazed at Takechiyo.

ja.t: つめていたときより、むしろずっと

units.source_zh: 大家都没说话，但也没有悲壮之感，气氛反而比广忠注视着竹千代时轻松多了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 广忠端起素陶的酒杯，饮了一口，递给众人。大家都没说话，但也没有悲壮之感，气氛反而比广忠注视着竹千代时轻松多了。

paragraphs.source_en: “Let us give them a battle to remember.” Ōkubo Jinshirō passed the cup to Honda Heihachirō.

units.source_en: “Let us give them a battle to remember.”

ja.t: れしてやろうではないか」

units.source_zh: “让我们大干一场吧。”

units.source_en: Ōkubo Jinshirō passed the cup to Honda Heihachirō.
units.source_zh: 大久保甚四郎将杯子递给本多平八郎。

paragraphs.source_zh: “让我们大干一场吧。”大久保甚四郎将杯子递给本多平八郎。

paragraphs.source_en: “Indeed!” Clad in a brand-new suit of armor, Heihachirō gave a hearty laugh.

units.source_en: “Indeed!”
Clad in a brand-new suit of armor, Heihachirō gave a hearty laugh.
units.source_zh: 平八郎穿着一身崭新的铠甲，呵呵一笑。

paragraphs.source_zh: “好！”平八郎穿着一身崭新的铠甲，呵呵一笑。

paragraphs.source_en: The warhorses had already been led into the courtyard when one suddenly whinnied. The cup passed back into Hirotada’s hands. “Is everyone ready?” He rose and dashed the earthenware cup violently to pieces.

units.source_en: The warhorses had already been led into the courtyard when one suddenly whinnied.
units.source_zh: 战马已经被牵到庭院里，突然间嘶鸣起来。

units.source_en: The cup passed back into Hirotada’s hands.
units.source_zh: 杯子又被传回到广忠手里。

units.source_en: “Is everyone ready?”
units.source_zh: “各位都准备好了吗？”

units.source_en: He rose and dashed the earthenware cup violently to pieces.
units.source_zh: 他立起身，猛地将素陶酒杯摔了个粉碎。

paragraphs.source_zh: 战马已经被牵到庭院里，突然间嘶鸣起来。杯子又被传回到广忠手里。“各位都准备好了吗？”他立起身，猛地将素陶酒杯摔了个粉碎。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ooh—ooh—ooh!” The men raised their great swords and roared in unison. Led by Abe Shirōgorō, they went out into the courtyard. The listlessness in the air sat strangely with the solemn ceremony of departure for battle. One-Eyed Hachiya led Hirotada’s horse before him.

units.source_en: “Ooh—ooh—ooh!” The men raised their great swords and roared in unison.

ja.t: 「おおーっ、おおーっ、おおーっ！」

units.source_zh: “噢——噢——噢——”众人举起大刀，齐声呐喊。

units.source_en: Led by Abe Shirōgorō, they went out into the courtyard.
units.source_zh: 由阿部四郎五郎打头，大家到了院中。

units.source_en: The listlessness in the air sat strangely with the solemn ceremony of departure for battle.
units.source_zh: 空气里的散漫气氛，和庄严的出征仪式很不相称。

units.source_en: One-Eyed Hachiya led Hirotada’s horse before him.
units.source_zh: 独眼八弥将马牵到了广忠跟前。

paragraphs.source_zh: “噢——噢——噢——”众人举起大刀，齐声呐喊。由阿部四郎五郎打头，大家到了院中。空气里的散漫气氛，和庄严的出征仪式很不相称。独眼八弥将马牵到了广忠跟前。

paragraphs.source_en: “Father… Father… ah…” Takechiyo’s voice came again from behind them…

units.source_en: “Father… Father… ah…” Takechiyo’s voice came again from behind them…
units.source_zh: “爹⋯⋯爹⋯⋯啊⋯⋯”身后又传来竹千代的声音⋯⋯

paragraphs.source_zh: “爹⋯⋯爹⋯⋯啊⋯⋯”身后又传来竹千代的声音⋯⋯

paragraphs.source_en: Before dawn, the men of Okazaki set out. According to the previous day’s intelligence, Oda Nobuhide’s reinforcements had not yet reached Anshō Castle. The garrison numbered about six hundred. As Hachiya brushed aside the dew-soaked grass, he thought that the enemy probably knew nothing of this surprise attack, and that they could therefore strike directly at the enemy commander.

units.source_en: Before dawn, the men of Okazaki set out.
units.source_zh: 天色未明，冈崎人便出发了。

units.source_en: According to the previous day’s intelligence, Oda Nobuhide’s reinforcements had not yet reached Anshō Castle.
units.source_zh: 根据昨天的消息，织田信秀的援军还没到达安祥城。

units.source_en: The garrison numbered about six hundred.
units.source_zh: 守城兵士约有六百。

units.source_en: As Hachiya brushed aside the dew-soaked grass, he thought that the enemy probably knew nothing of this surprise attack, and that they could therefore strike directly at the enemy commander.
units.source_zh: 八弥一边拍打着被露水打湿的小草，一边想，敌人恐还不知这次奇袭，如此便可直取敌人大将。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天色未明，冈崎人便出发了。根据昨天的消息，织田信秀的援军还没到达安祥城。守城兵士约有六百。八弥一边拍打着被露水打湿的小草，一边想，敌人恐还不知这次奇袭，如此便可直取敌人大将。

paragraphs.source_en: “I have been too cruel!” Even on horseback, Hirotada was still thinking about it. Lady Tahara had still never shared Hirotada’s bed. Hirotada favored only Ohāru and had never touched Lady Tahara. She harbored deep resentment over this. Moreover, she possessed neither Odai’s gentleness nor the intelligence and charm that drew Hirotada to her.

units.source_en: “I have been too cruel!”
units.source_zh: “我太残忍了！”

units.source_en: Even on horseback, Hirotada was still thinking about it.
units.source_zh: 广忠在马背上还在想着这件事。

units.source_en: Lady Tahara had still never shared Hirotada’s bed.
units.source_zh: 田原夫人至今未与广忠同房。

units.source_en: Hirotada favored only Ohāru and had never touched Lady Tahara.
units.source_zh: 广忠只宠幸阿春，未碰过田原夫人。

units.source_en: She harbored deep resentment over this.
units.source_zh: 夫人对此心怀怨恨。

units.source_en: Moreover, she possessed neither Odai’s gentleness nor the intelligence and charm that drew Hirotada to her.
units.source_zh: 而且，她不具有於大那样的温柔和吸引广忠的智慧与魅力。

paragraphs.source_zh: “我太残忍了！”广忠在马背上还在想着这件事。田原夫人至今未与广忠同房。广忠只宠幸阿春，未碰过田原夫人。夫人对此心怀怨恨。而且，她不具有於大那样的温柔和吸引广忠的智慧与魅力。

paragraphs.source_en: At the urging of his elderly retainers, Hirotada would occasionally visit Nidō Castle, but whenever he arrived, Lady Tahara would begin nagging him without end.

units.source_en: At the urging of his elderly retainers, Hirotada would occasionally visit Nidō Castle, but whenever he arrived, Lady Tahara would begin nagging him without end.
units.source_zh: 在老臣们的劝告下，广忠偶尔也会造访二道城，他一到那里，田原夫人便会没完没了地絮叨起来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在老臣们的劝告下，广忠偶尔也会造访二道城，他一到那里，田原夫人便会没完没了地絮叨起来。

paragraphs.source_en: At some point Lady Tahara had begun denouncing Hirotada as incompetent behind his back and mocking him for loving a lowly maidservant instead of her. Whenever word of this reached him, a nameless fire of vexation and anger flared in Hirotada’s breast.

units.source_en: At some point Lady Tahara had begun denouncing Hirotada as incompetent behind his back and mocking him for loving a lowly maidservant instead of her.
units.source_zh: 不知从何时开始，田原夫人开始在背后骂广忠无能，嘲笑他爱上一个卑微的侍女，却不爱她。

units.source_en: Whenever word of this reached him, a nameless fire of vexation and anger flared in Hirotada’s breast.
units.source_zh: 每当听到这些话，广忠胸中便腾起一股焦急而愤怒的无名之火。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不知从何时开始，田原夫人开始在背后骂广忠无能，嘲笑他爱上一个卑微的侍女，却不爱她。每当听到这些话，广忠胸中便腾起一股焦急而愤怒的无名之火。

paragraphs.source_en: As he brooded on this, a horn suddenly sounded at the head of the column. Day had fully broken, and milky morning mist struck cold against his face.

units.source_en: As he brooded on this, a horn suddenly sounded at the head of the column.
units.source_zh: 正想着，突然，队列前响起了号角声。

units.source_en: Day had fully broken, and milky morning mist struck cold against his face.
units.source_zh: 天已大亮，乳汁一般的晨雾冰冷地扑到脸上。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正想着，突然，队列前响起了号角声。天已大亮，乳汁一般的晨雾冰冷地扑到脸上。

paragraphs.source_en: “We are about to storm the castle. Let me stress it once more: no one is to act rashly!” Abe Ōkura, the standard-bearer, came riding through the morning mist.

units.source_en: “We are about to storm the castle. Let me stress it once more: no one is to act rashly!”
units.source_zh: “马上便要攻城，再强调一遍，不可轻举妄动！”

units.source_en: Abe Ōkura, the standard-bearer, came riding through the morning mist.
units.source_zh: 晨雾中，旗手官阿部大藏跑了过来。

paragraphs.source_zh: “马上便要攻城，再强调一遍，不可轻举妄动！”晨雾中，旗手官阿部大藏跑了过来。

paragraphs.source_en: Hirotada acknowledged him and nodded firmly. Ōkura’s eyes told him that the men had entered that tense, fevered state which precedes battle. To Hirotada, who had been fighting on battlefields since the age of eleven or twelve, there was nothing unusual in the air here.

units.source_en: Hirotada acknowledged him and nodded firmly.
units.source_zh: 广忠应了一声，重重点了点头。

units.source_en: Ōkura’s eyes told him that the men had entered that tense, fevered state which precedes battle.
units.source_zh: 大藏的眼神告诉他，他们已经进入战斗前紧张而亢奋的状态。

units.source_en: To Hirotada, who had been fighting on battlefields since the age of eleven or twelve, there was nothing unusual in the air here.
units.source_zh: 对于十一二岁便开始征战疆场的广忠来说，这里的空气并无异常之处。

paragraphs.source_zh: 广忠应了一声，重重点了点头。大藏的眼神告诉他，他们已经进入战斗前紧张而亢奋的状态。对于十一二岁便开始征战疆场的广忠来说，这里的空气并无异常之处。

paragraphs.source_en: Once battle began, no one could know who would live or die. The moment he rode out of the castle, Hirotada felt that his body no longer belonged to him. “Ōkura, keep advancing!”

units.source_en: Once battle began, no one could know who would live or die.
units.source_zh: 战端一起，生死难测。

units.source_en: The moment he rode out of the castle, Hirotada felt that his body no longer belonged to him.

ja.t: のものではないように

units.source_zh: 一旦出了城，广忠便感觉身体已不属于自己。

units.source_en: “Ōkura, keep advancing!”
units.source_zh: “大藏，继续前进！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 战端一起，生死难测。一旦出了城，广忠便感觉身体已不属于自己。“大藏，继续前进！”

paragraphs.source_en: The headquarters was established on a rise southwest of Anshō Castle. The formation was complete before the morning mist vanished, and the men waited silently for the signal standard to be raised. Abe Ōkura commanded the force, while Uemura Shinrokurō and the spear-bearing One-Eyed Hachiya guarded Hirotada.

units.source_en: The headquarters was established on a rise southwest of Anshō Castle. The formation was complete before the morning mist vanished, and the men waited silently for the signal standard to be raised.
units.source_zh: 主阵安排在安祥城西南角的一个土坡上，已经在晨雾消失之前布阵完毕，静待令旗一举。

units.source_en: Abe Ōkura commanded the force, while Uemura Shinrokurō and the spear-bearing One-Eyed Hachiya guarded Hirotada.
units.source_zh: 指挥队伍的是阿部大藏，负责护卫广忠的是植村新六郎和手持长枪的独眼八弥。

paragraphs.source_zh: 主阵安排在安祥城西南角的一个土坡上，已经在晨雾消失之前布阵完毕，静待令旗一举。指挥队伍的是阿部大藏，负责护卫广忠的是植村新六郎和手持长枪的独眼八弥。

paragraphs.source_en: Shouts continually rang out from the surrounding morning mist. The enemy was nowhere to be seen. No doubt they were frantically preparing for battle. The rise ahead looked like a landscape painted in ink. Suddenly a flock of sparrows burst from the rice field ahead, almost blotting the rise from view.

units.source_en: Shouts continually rang out from the surrounding morning mist.
units.source_zh: 周围的晨雾中不断传来吆喝声。

units.source_en: The enemy was nowhere to be seen.
units.source_zh: 敌人不见踪影。

units.source_en: No doubt they were frantically preparing for battle.
units.source_zh: 无疑，他们正在慌乱地备战。

units.source_en: The rise ahead looked like a landscape painted in ink.
units.source_zh: 前方的土坡仿佛一幅水墨画。

units.source_en: Suddenly a flock of sparrows burst from the rice field ahead, almost blotting the rise from view.
units.source_zh: 忽然从前面的稻田里惊起一群麻雀，几乎遮住了土坡。

paragraphs.source_zh: 周围的晨雾中不断传来吆喝声。敌人不见踪影。无疑，他们正在慌乱地备战。前方的土坡仿佛一幅水墨画。忽然从前面的稻田里惊起一群麻雀，几乎遮住了土坡。

paragraphs.source_en: Abe Ōkura could not help reining in his horse. “My lord!” he called. But Hirotada did not hear him. Through the thinning morning mist, he kept urging his horse onward.

units.source_en: Abe Ōkura could not help reining in his horse.
units.source_zh: 阿部大藏不禁停下马来。

units.source_en: “My lord!”
units.source_zh: “主公！”

units.source_en: he called.
units.source_zh: 他叫道。

units.source_en: But Hirotada did not hear him. Through the thinning morning mist, he kept urging his horse onward.
units.source_zh: 但广忠没有听到，在逐渐消逝的晨雾中，他不时催马前行。

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿部大藏不禁停下马来。“主公！”他叫道。但广忠没有听到，在逐渐消逝的晨雾中，他不时催马前行。

paragraphs.source_en: The sun climbed high. The golden fan horse standard inherited from his father Kiyoyasu gleamed beautifully in the morning mist, while his fully armed retainers were already making straight for the hill.

units.source_en: The sun climbed high.
units.source_zh: 太阳高高升起。

units.source_en: Now that Oda Nobuhide had appeared, what hope of victory could Okazaki possibly have?
units.source_zh: 既然织田信秀已经出现，冈崎焉有胜机？

units.source_en: That elusive and formidable commander had undoubtedly already severed Hirotada’s path of retreat.
units.source_zh: 那个神出鬼没的猛将，无疑已经切断了广忠的退路。

paragraphs.source_zh: “唉！”八弥低声叹道。既然织田信秀已经出现，冈崎焉有胜机？那个神出鬼没的猛将，无疑已经切断了广忠的退路。
